mapper.insert: INSERT INTO luck_business_knowledge (id, business_term, description, synonyms, enabled, model_id, embedding_status, error_msg, is_deleted, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{businessTerm}, #{description}, #{synonyms}, #{enabled}, #{modelId}, #{embeddingStatus}, #{errorMsg}, #{isDeleted}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, business_term, description, synonyms, enabled, model_id, embedding_status, error_msg, is_deleted, created_time, updated_time FROM luck_business_knowledge WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, business_term, description, synonyms, enabled, model_id, embedding_status, error_msg, is_deleted, created_time, updated_time FROM luck_business_knowledge WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (business_term LIKE #{keywordPattern} OR description LIKE #{keywordPattern} OR synonyms LIKE #{keywordPattern}) ORDER BY created_time DESC
